description.value: Baan Thai (operating as Bann Thai Restaurant) is a sit-down Thai restaurant located on the second floor in the heart of downtown Campbell River, opposite Spirit Square where 11th Ave meets Shoppers Row. The menu spans Thai classics — Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup, curries, seafood, and noodle dishes — alongside a full licensed bar with wines, imported beers including Singha, and cocktails. Curry dishes are explicitly labeled gluten-free, and takeout is available alongside dine-in service.

address.value: 1090 B Shoppers Row, Campbell River, BC
